items.q: What is an AI receptionist for hotels?
items.a: An AI receptionist answers your hotel's phone line like a trained front-desk agent. {brand} picks up every call, answers questions about rooms, rates and facilities, takes bookings and guest requests, and passes the call to your staff when a person is needed.
{brand} speaks 30+ languages on the Professional and Enterprise plans, and 5 on Starter. She detects the caller's language from the first sentence and switches automatically.

items.q: Does {brand} work with my property management system?
items.a: Yes. {brand} works with Opera, Mews, Cloudbeds, Apaleo and other common PMS and booking tools, so she can check live availability, quote rates and book rooms directly — without OTA commission.

items.q: What happens when a guest needs a real person?
items.a: {brand} warm-transfers the call to the right member of your team with a short summary, or takes a message and routes it when nobody is available — for example at night.
Most hotels go live within days. You connect your PMS and forward your phone line; no hardware is needed. We tune {brand}'s answers to your property before launch.

sheet.ask: She'll ask about your hotel and walk you through the site as you talk.
